history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration formulate a policy for the ICT support model to support the Organization in continuing to have staff work remotely and safely during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests that this recommendation be closed. The revised Secretary-General’s bulletin on the use of United Nations resources and data, which will incorporate the use of technology in the context of remote working, especially the use of personal mobile devices, is being issued in accordance with the relevant established process. The process of issuing a policy involves multiple offices, which may cause delays. The Secretary-General’s bulletin is under revision.
history.board_assessment: Given that the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic has passed, the Board considers the recommendation to be overtaken by events.
